address.description: Destination URI to which the webhook subscription should send the POST request when an event occurs.
address.title: Address URL

format.description: Format in which the webhook subscription should send the data. Valid values are JSON and XML. Defaults to JSON.
format.title: Format

items.description: Name of a specific resource property to include in the payload.

fields.description: An optional array of top-level resource fields that should be serialized and sent in the POST request. If absent, all fields will be sent.
fields.title: Fields

webhook.description: The webhook subscription parameters to create.
webhook.title: Webhook

description: Payload containing the configuration to register a new webhook subscription.
